Hi Lara —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Recap: You and I + Rishi went through Acme's ingestion patterns and data residency needs. Main asks were: SOC 2 status, DPA with SCCs for EU transfers, and the vendor security questionnaire your procurement team will run.
- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II in production; I can connect you to the secure report under NDA (Neha will help).
- DPA / SCCs: Redwood executes a standard DPA and we adopt the EU Commission’s controller-to-processor SCCs for customer transfers. We typically align roles such that Acme is Controller and Redwood is Processor. If you have internal legal preferences for specific SCC modules, let us know — happy to align.
- Vendor questionnaire: we'll start the questionnaire in parallel. Rishi / Neha will take the lead on technical/security Qs.

Proposed next steps: 
1) I’ll send our DPA draft for your legal review (attached).
2) Rishi/Neha start the vendor security questionnaire and share our SOC2 access link under NDA.
3) Can you confirm Acme’s target sign date for procurement? That will help prioritize turnaround.

Attaching: Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.pdf (DPA draft).

Thanks — talk soon.

—Marissa
